Job.description: Full record — the source of truth persisted as `jobs/<id>.json`.
Job.title: Job

JobCreate.description: Form fields for creating a job. Inputs are immutable once set.
JobCreate.title: JobCreate

JobMetrics.description: Quantitative outcome of one completed inference run.
JobMetrics.title: JobMetrics

JobStats.description: Dashboard aggregates over the sample's prefixes.
JobStats.title: JobStats

JobSummary.description: Compact record for the Segmentations table (one per jobs/<id>.json).
JobSummary.title: JobSummary

JobUpdate.description:
Editable metadata ONLY. Inputs (volume/model/modality) are immutable by
design — a job records one inference on one volume; to change the input,
create a new job. All fields optional; only provided ones change.
JobUpdate.title: JobUpdate

LabelVolume.description: Physical volume of one segmented label.
LabelVolume.title: LabelVolume

PresignUploadRequest.description: What the browser declares before uploading directly to B2.
PresignUploadRequest.title: PresignUploadRequest

PresignUploadResponse.description:
A short-lived presigned PUT the browser uploads to, plus the exact
headers it must send. `Content-Length` and `content-type` are signed into
the URL, so B2 rejects a body of any other size or type.
PresignUploadResponse.title: PresignUploadResponse

VerifyUploadRequest.description: Sent after the direct PUT so the API can inspect the stored object.
VerifyUploadRequest.title: VerifyUploadRequest

VolumeSummary.description:
One ingested volume, plus the site/modality/patient parsed from its key.

Keys seeded by `pnpm run seed` follow
`volumes/<site>/<modality>/<patient>/<file>`; browser-ingested volumes land
flat under `volumes/<file>` and leave the parsed fields null.
VolumeSummary.title: VolumeSummary

info.description: Local API for nnU-Net 3D Medical Image Segmentation: ingest 3D CT/MRI volumes, run real nnU-Net inference on-device, and archive every artifact (raw volumes, preprocessed tensors, masks, and the model checkpoint) on Backblaze B2 over the S3-compatible API. This contract documents the local API, not a hosted public endpoint.
info.title: nnU-Net 3D Medical Image Segmentation API

get.description:
Rich metadata (checksums, image/PDF fields) recomputed on demand.

Unlike /metadata (a cheap head_object), this downloads the object to
re-run extraction, so it is billed at the tighter 'write' rate-limit tier
(see runtime/ratelimit.py) to bound egress/cost amplification.
get.summary: Get File Detail By Key Endpoint

post.description:
Validate a declared upload and hand back a presigned PUT.

The browser uploads the bytes straight to B2 with the returned URL, so they
never traverse this Function — that is what lifts Vercel's ~4.5 MB payload
ceiling. Size and content-type are signed into the URL (see the service).
Confirm an object just uploaded directly to B2 is valid and visible.
